g.text: Open PR → GitHub App signs → tunnel → pr-agent verifies HMAC → DeepSeek v4-pro → review comment
1 · A PR is opened or synchronized on an installed repo. GitHub fires the pull_request event.
2 · GitHub App POSTs to /api/v1/github_webhooks, body signed X-Hub-Signature-256 (HMAC).
3 · Cloudflare edge (ACCESS-EXEMPT) → cloudflared → proxies to localhost:3000.
4 · pr-agent recomputes HMAC with GITHUB__WEBHOOK_SECRET. Mismatch rejects; match handles.
5 · pr-agent calls DeepSeek v4-pro (OPENAI__API_BASE = api.deepseek.com) for the review.
6 · pr-agent posts the review to the PR via the GitHub API as the App (install token).
